test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (Quant) (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: maths
question: P can finish a work in 18 days. When he had worked for 5 days, Q joined him. If both of them together completed the remaining work in (13)/(5) days, then in how many days can Q alone finish 66(2)/(3) % of the same work?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Remaining work for P = 18 − 5 = 13 days of P's work.

(P + Q) completes this in 13/5 days ⇒ (P + Q) × 13/5 = P × 13.

Efficiency Ratio (P + Q) : P = 5 : 1 ⇒ Efficiency of Q = 4 (if P = 1).

Total work = 18 × 1 = 18 units; 66 2/3% of work = 2/3 × 18 = 12 units.

Time taken by Q alone = 12 ÷ 4 = 3 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: P can finish work in 18 days. Worked for 5 days. Rem. work done with Q in 13/5 days.

Formula: Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time | Time = Work ÷ Efficiency

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 P
 18
 18 units
 18 ÷ 18 = 1
 
 

 Q
 -
 5 − 1 = 4
 
 

⇒ Work completed by P in 5 days = 1 × 5 = 5 units.

⇒ Remaining work = 18 − 5 = 13 units.

⇒ Efficiency of (P + Q) = Remaining Work ÷ Time = 13 ÷ (13/5) = 5 units/day.

⇒ Efficiency of Q = (Efficiency of P + Q) − (Efficiency of P) = 5 − 1 = 4 units/day.

⇒ 66 2/3% of Total Work = (200/3)% × 18 = 2/3 × 18 = 12 units.

⇒ Time taken by Q = 12 ÷ 4 = 3 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Efficiency Relation

Efficiency is inversely proportional to time taken. If P is thrice as efficient as Q, time taken ratio P:Q = 1:3.

Work and Wages

Wages are distributed in the ratio of work done or efficiency (if time is same). Wage = Efficiency × Time.

Fraction to Percentage Conversion

Common values: 33 1/3% = 1/3, 66 2/3% = 2/3, 16 2/3% = 1/6, and 12 1/2% = 1/8.

Combined Work Formula

If A takes 'a' days and B takes 'b' days, together they take (a × b) ÷ (a + b) days.</p
